taiwan-ncpc-2012.notes: The copy is a single PDF (the MOE contest guidelines), saved under a .php name; it states that Groups A and B compete on 2012-10-20 and Group C on 2012-10-21, at two sites at once.

sources.evidence: Six-page PDF titled 教育部 101 年度全國大專電腦軟體設計競賽 競賽要點 giving the rules of the 2012 national contest, with Group A (甲組) on 101/10/20.

taiwan-ncpc-2014.notes: The crawl mixes many years of the MOE national software design contest sites (ncpc.ntnu.edu.tw and ncpc.nsysu.edu.tw, captures 2002-2025, seed PDFs of 2015 problems cut short at 1 MB). Its 2014 pages are news of the MOE year-103 contest (registration to 103/9/25, preliminary round 10/4/2014). A human should decide whether the catalogue's '2014 ACM-ICPC Taiwan NCPU National Programming Contest' (2014-06-25, Taichung) is that MOE contest; if it is, the crawl is the series site with a few pages of this edition.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader judged the crawl not to be a source of this contest; it does hold news pages of the MOE contest's 2014 (year 103) edition, but whether that edition is the catalogue's June 2014 NCPU contest cannot be told from the copy.
sources.evidence: The 144 saved files are captures, from 2002 to 2025, of the Ministry of Education national collegiate software design contest sites of National Taiwan Normal University and National Sun Yat-sen University; a few 2014 news pages (year 103, preliminary round on 10/4) are of that contest, and nothing names a 2014 NCPU contest or a contest on 25 June 2014 in Taichung.

taiwan-ncpc-2016.notes: The article gives only the universities placed first to third and an honourable mention for the host; it is a partial ranking (top 3).

sources.evidence: China Times news article of 2016/07/02 on the first national programming contest of technology universities held by National Formosa University, naming the first three teams' universities and 30 participating teams.
